# Native Apple Silicon benchmark evidence

- Compiler: `Clang 23.1.3`
- Kernel flags: `-std=c17 -O3 -mcpu=native -ffp-contract=fast` (no `-ffast-math`; no LTO)
- Scalar-control flags: `-fno-vectorize -fno-slp-vectorize -fno-builtin-memcpy`
- Host: `Darwin 27.0.0 arm64`
- Run time: `2026-10-13T05:38:13+0530`
- Protocol: 5 warmups, auto-calibrated 100 ms batches, 11 samples, median and MAD; sample order rotates
- Quality gate: every kernel/shape must have MAD <= 5.0%
- Data: deterministic FP32 inputs; 64-byte-aligned, disjoint buffers; warm-cache inference
- Scheduling: benchmark thread requests macOS user-interactive QoS

## Isolating SIMD from loop-order/locality gains

The scalar control has the same aligned IKJ source shape but is compiled with both loop and SLP vectorization disabled.

| 1x256x128 | 6.337 | 2.059 | 3.08x |
| 1x256x256 | 12.426 | 4.878 | 2.55x |
| 4x256x256 | 48.782 | 19.242 | 2.54x |
